q: For the WellNest attorney: can you send a screenshot of The Cocoon's Instagram post or profile showing it is renaming to "Wellnest"? The attorney needs it as proof of their use of the name.

Approve a full clearance search for 'Smart Upkeep' (comprehensive trademark search) plus attorney opinion for about $1,700–$3,000, and hold the van wrap, signs and print until it is back (about 2 weeks)?
d: What it covers: a full search of federal (USPTO) filings, all 50 state registries, common-law use (businesses using the name without registering it) and domain names. Why an attorney opinion: our free check found medium-high risk on the name, and a lawyer's written opinion says whether it's safe to use and file, which protects you if someone objects later. Cost: Cionca IP is $1,700 (search plus opinion) and Gerben IP is $3,000 (search, opinion letter and filing). Time: about 2 weeks, so the van wrap, signs and print would wait until it's back.

q: Approve a legal and tax budget of about $5,000: Killeen Law (Detroit, flat fee) for privacy and terms, with a flat-fee trademark firm, and Bright!Tax for cross-border tax?
d: Killeen Law PLLC (Detroit) writes the privacy policy and member terms, flat fee, mostly $2,000 to $4,000. It doesn't list trademark work. A flat-fee trademark firm (Cionca IP, Gerben IP or Morris Turek) handles the name search, opinion and federal filing: $350 for a federal-only search, $1,700 to $3,000 for full packages. Proposed budget: about $5,000 for the lawyer and the accountant (my estimate), on top of the search.

q: Pick the Standard cyber and E&O tier: $1M cyber + $1M E&O, about $1,500–$3,000 a year? Details in Document Center: 'UpKeep Cyber and E&O Tiers, Oct 17'. (no purchase or quote request until you OK it)
d: The $1,500–$3,000 range checks out against published medians: cyber about $1,552 a year (Insureon, small businesses) plus E&O about $989 (Insureon, home inspectors, $1M/$1M), which comes to about $2,500. Light option: E&O $1M plus a $100k–$250k cyber add-on, about $700–$1,500. Higher option: $2M–$3M cyber plus $2M E&O, about $3,000–$6,000 (estimate). Cyber covers breach response, ransomware, business interruption and member data lawsuits. Funds transfer fraud is usually a smaller sublimit. E&O covers claims of a missed problem in an inspection. Damage in a member's home is general liability (about $545 a year), not E&O. A licensed Michigan broker should quote it.
